prose: Worlds will collide tonight as the Spider-Verse dream team convenes for a magical livestream about the strange secrets & occult occurrences connecting Jack Parsons of JPL, Crowley, dark occult rituals, the founding of NASA, and much more. With mystic perspectives from Slick Dissident, symbolic syncretism from Mario Garza, astrological evidence from Kayleigh Berkana, and the jovial rabbit holes Juan Ayala has been digging, this promises to be an extravagant exploration.
